Dubai: gold climbed to AED 511.18 a gram (24K) on today's board, up 1.45%, still an intraday reading before New York's close settles.

دبي: ارتفع الذهب إلى 511.18 درهمًا لعيار 24 على تعرفة اليوم، بارتفاع 1.45%، وهي قراءة لحظية قبل إقفال نيويورك.

22K stands at AED 468.59 a gram and silver at AED 7,605 a kilogram, both up with the metal itself (gold spot $4,329.30/oz, silver $64.41/oz via Kitco, AED/USD 3.6725 peg). No street story cleared today's bar; the tape carries the morning alone.

Carat Capital tape, 16 September (intraday reading); Kitco spot.
